subject: Re: Marketplace procurement path & PO vs card \u0014 Redwood inference
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Miller <tom.miller@lumen.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 06 Feb 2027 18:15:00 -0800
Subject: LumenAI / Redwood — procurement path & marketplace follow-up

Hi Tom,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to learn more about LumenAI's platform goals and where inference fits into your roadmap. Quick summary and proposed next steps: 

Summary:
- You want predictable inference costs and the ability to scale to production workloads across AWS.
- Procurement preference: PO for larger deals, vendor onboarding via your procurement team (Ariba).
- Marketplace interest: potentially AWS Marketplace (private offer) but you need confirmation from procurement.

Questions / asks:
1) Can you confirm your PO threshold (amount above which you require a PO vs card)?
2) Does procurement require a vendor questionnaire (we can provide SOC2, encryption details, and data-flow diagrams)?
3) Are you interested in pursuing an AWS Marketplace private offer (we can support listing + private offers) or would you prefer a direct Redwood contract and invoicing?

Next steps:
- I attached a preliminary quote and a draft SOW for your review (Redwood-Quote-LumenAI-20270206.pdf, SOW-draft.docx).
- If procurement prefers marketplace, I’ll loop in Sales Ops to kick off the AWS Marketplace intake.
- If PO path is required, Camila and Marissa (cc'd) will start vendor paperwork and provide the PO billing flow.

Would love to confirm timing — would a procurement kickoff next week work?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Office: (415) 555-0183

---
Attachment: Redwood-Quote-LumenAI-20270206.pdf (1 page, pricing summary)
Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (SOW v0.2)

From: Tom Miller <tom.miller@lumen.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lumen.ai>
Date: Sun, 07 Feb 2027 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LumenAI / Redwood — procurement path & marketplace follow-up

Neha — thanks for the recap and materials. A few quick answers from procurement: 

- PO threshold: we require a PO for purchases >= $25,000.
- Vendor onboarding: we use SAP Ariba; we’ll need your W-9, SOC 2 Type II report, and insurer details.
- Marketplace: procurement has a preference for AWS Marketplace because it simplifies billing across business units, but they need to confirm that the pricing and private offer flow will meet our approvals.
- Timeline: onboarding + PO issuance is typically 2–4 weeks once we have the vendor packet.

We are interested in the AWS Marketplace private offer option if Redwood supports metered SaaS or private listing. Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 
1) List as a SaaS subscription (metered) on AWS Marketplace, and
2) Accept a private offer tied to our account (we will route payment via PO).

Tom
Tom Miller
Head of Platform, LumenAI
tom.miller@lumen.ai
+1 (617) 555-2345

Subject: Re: LumenAI / Redwood — procurement path & marketplace follow-up

Tom — really helpful, thanks. To confirm from our side: 

- Redwood supports AWS Marketplace SaaS listings with metering and private offers. We also support direct invoicing and PO billing for customers who prefer a direct Redwood contract.
- For a private offer on AWS Marketplace we’ll need to coordinate a listing intake with our Marketplace team (Camila/Marissa cc'd). That process typically involves: listing intake, packaging the offer (metered vs subscription), and then creating the private offer tied to your AWS account.
- For PO billing we can accept PO terms and invoice per agreed milestones/intervals; our Finance team will provide net-30/45 payment terms per the contract.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Camila/Marissa start the marketplace intake (I'll let them confirm timelines).
2) Tom / Procurement — please send the required vendor packet items (W-9, SOC2 recipient, insurer) to procurement@redwood.ai so we can kick off Ariba/vendor onboarding.
3) I'll schedule a short procurement kickoff (30 minutes) next week to align on marketplace vs direct contract and confirm timeline.

If helpful I can also share our standard AWS Marketplace docs and a sample private offer flow. I’ve included the quote and SOW for budgeting; if procurement wants an invoice-only path we can prepare paperwork for PO.

Thanks — will follow up once Camila/Marissa confirm marketplace intake time.

Best,
Neha

Subject: Fwd: LumenAI / Redwood — procurement path & marketplace follow-up

Forwarding Tom's procurement note — Marissa, can you start the AWS Marketplace intake and confirm whether we should propose a metered SaaS or annual subscription for LumenAI? Details below from Tom: PO threshold $25k, Ariba onboarding, preference for Marketplace but needs pricing in private offer.

Checklist for intake (quick):
- Confirm meter type (tokens/month or instance-hours) — ask product for recommended metering for inference workloads.
- Prepare vendor packet (W-9, SOC2 link, insurance) — finance can push to procurement.
- Draft private offer terms and list pricing that maps to the attached quote.

Marissa — can you also confirm expected lead time for listing and private offer creation? I’ll propose a 30-min procurement call for Thurs or Fri next week.

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes

Estimated contract: ~$60,000 annual (initial). PO threshold confirmed at $25k — so we'll issue a PO and route payment against the private offer.

Next steps from our side: 
- I'll circulate our vendor packet (W-9, vendor form) by end of day tomorrow.
- Please provide Marketplace listing intake and a suggested meter (tokens vs vCPU-hrs) so we can confirm budgeting line items.
- Schedule the procurement kickoff — Thursday 11 Feb at 10:00 AM ET works for us.
